description: Publishes the records a WakeWorks dealership needs to send email from its own domain through Resend (Amazon SES): a bounce MX and SPF on send.<host>, a DKIM key on resend._domainkey.<host>, and, only when the domain has none, a monitoring-only DMARC policy. Group 'sending' is always applied; group 'dmarc' is applied only when WakeWorks found no existing DMARC record, so an existing policy is never replaced.
variableDescription: dkim: the Resend DKIM public key value for this domain, 'p=' followed by base64. region: the Amazon SES region in the bounce MX host, e.g. us-east-1.
